 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cristiano Ronaldo will not be part of the Al Nassr squad as they head to Uzbekistan to take on Pakhtakor in the AFC Champions League Elite on Monday, November 2. The Portuguese superstar is reportedly resting as the Saudi Arabian outfit is in a hectic period.
 The visitors will also have plenty of attacking quality with Joao Felix and Sadio Mane likely to spearhead the attack at Pakhtakor Stadium. The home side will try to benefit from home support as they seek their first win in the competition this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement What Time Does Pakhtakor vs. Al Nassr Start?
 The AFC Champions League Elite Round 4 match will be played at Pakhtakor Stadium, Tashkent, Uzbekistan, on Monday, November 2. Kickoff will be at 6:45 p.m. local time.
 United States (ET): 8:45 a.m.
 United States (PT): 5:45 a.m.
 United Kingdom (GMT): 1:45 p.m.
 Germany (CET): 2:45 p.m.
 Saudi Arabia (AST): 4:45 p.m.
 India (IST): 7:15 p.m.
 Australia (AEDT): 12:45 a.m. (November 3)
 Japan and South Korea: 10:45 p.m.
 Al Nassr's Portuguese forward #07 Cristiano Ronaldo is seen prior to the start of the Saudi Pro League football match between Al-Nassr and Diriyah FC at Al-Awwal Park.(Photo by Fayez NURELDINE / AFP via Getty Images)
 Al Nassr come into the game with three points from two games, while Pakhtakor are 12th with two points from three games. The Saudi side has a chance to consolidate its position, and the Uzbek hosts are in dire need of a positive outcome to boost their chances of qualification.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Felix and Mane will have to take on more attacking burden as Al Nassr seek a significant away win without Ronaldo.
